claims: Max Verstappen is the youngest Formula 1 race winner in history.
Max Verstappen won the 2016 Spanish Grand Prix at 18 years and 228 days old.
Max Verstappen, driving for Red Bull Racing, broke Sebastian Vettel's previous record.
Kimi Antonelli won the 2026 Chinese Grand Prix at 19 years and 202 days old.
Kimi Antonelli became the second-youngest Formula 1 race winner.
Sebastian Vettel won the 2008 Italian GP at 21 years, 73 days.
Charles Leclerc won the 2019 Belgian GP at 21 years, 320 days.
Fernando Alonso won the 2003 Hungarian GP at 22 years, 26 days.
